title.narrative: RAM on Neurotechnology in Nigeria: Awareness, Assessment, and Ethical Governance.

description.narrative: This project will focus on conducting a multi-dimensional assessment of Nigeria readiness for neurotechnology in alignment with the UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of Neurotechnology. It begins with awareness creation on ethical issues such as autonomy, mental privacy, freedom of thought, and risks of bias followed by a structured assessment. The outputs will guide Nigeria in developing national strategies, legislation, education programs, and capacity building initiatives which will also embed gender perspectives. This project hopes to ensure that Nigeria moves from assessment to action, embedding ethical governance of neurotechnology into national systems while aligning with UNESCO’s global framework.
